scope: Blind optical identities after final ownership. Same QSO before/after requires unique spectral identity in both signed cohorts. R morphology is the saved legacy r shape statistic and may be unavailable.

spectral_metadata_identity_audit.scope: Released spectral identity and origin only. Tiny positional tolerance handles numerical CSV round trips; both metadata and recovered identity must be unique.

spectral_geometric_opportunity_scope: Optical spectrum positions in actual registered SDSS scan and NSC CCD footprints, measured availability of calibrated groups, at least two late exposures, at least 0.6 yr late and 5 yr joint spans; individual target depth and independent identity are separate.
